verdict.rationale: The docs refer to a 'published app' and agent-driven deploy, and a hands-on community user reports building and deploying an app in 'two prompts and deploy', so publishing is a real built-in capability. No first-party doc describes a one-step publish flow or the resulting live URL. missing for 10: first-party documentation of a one-click publish action, explicit description of the default live URL assigned on publish, independent corroboration that publishing is a single step.
